Class SlotGroupRegionRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.inject.SlotGroupRegionRegistry
@Internal public final class SlotGroupRegionRegistry extends Object
Internal registry for SlotGroupContext panel registrations. Post-§0042 split companion to MenuKit's RegionRegistry (which holds MenuContext + HudContext registrations).

Holds process-lifetime per-(category, region) panel lists. Panels register once at mod init (during SlotGroupPanelAdapter.on(SlotGroupCategory...)) and remain registered until process exit.

Internal only. Consumers don't call this directly — the SlotGroupPanelAdapter.on(SlotGroupCategory...) method registers on their behalf.

  • Method Details

    • registerSlotGroup

      public static void registerSlotGroup(Panel panel, SlotGroupCategory category, SlotGroupRegion region, int padding, int priority)
      Registers a SlotGroupContext panel into a (category, region) pair with a content padding and explicit stacking priority. Called from SlotGroupPanelAdapter.on(SlotGroupCategory...) for each declared target category. A single adapter targeting N categories produces N registrations — each (category, region) key stacks independently.

      Priority + the captured caller modId drive the deterministic sort applied at axialPrefix(Panel, SlotGroupCategory, SlotGroupRegion) time (matching the Menu/HUD/Vanilla paths in RegionRegistry).

    • registerSlotGroup

      public static void registerSlotGroup(Panel panel, SlotGroupCategory category, SlotGroupRegion region, int padding)
      Back-compat overload — registers with RegionAnchor.DEFAULT_PRIORITY. Consumers that don't call SlotGroupRegion.priority(...) hit this path and still get a deterministic sort via the modId tiebreaker.

    • unregisterSlotGroup

      public static void unregisterSlotGroup(Panel panel)
      Phase 16j R5 — removes a previously-registered SlotGroupContext panel from every (category, region) bucket it appears in and clears its per-panel metadata. Idempotent. Symmetric counterpart to registerSlotGroup(Panel, SlotGroupCategory, SlotGroupRegion, int, int).

    • axialPrefix

      public static int axialPrefix(Panel self, SlotGroupCategory category, SlotGroupRegion region)
      Axial prefix for a SlotGroupContext panel anchored in a given (category, region) pair. Walks the per-key panel list, skipping hidden panels, and sums extent + RegionConstants.MENU_STACK_GAP for each visible preceding entry.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if self is not registered under (category, region)

    • warnSlotGroupOverflowOnce

      public static void warnSlotGroupOverflowOnce(Panel panel, SlotGroupCategory category, SlotGroupRegion region, int pw, int ph, int prefix, SlotGroupBounds bounds)
      Logs a one-shot warning the first time a SlotGroupContext panel overflows a given (category, region) pair. Called from SlotGroupPanelAdapter when SlotGroupRegionMath.resolveSlotGroup(SlotGroupRegion, SlotGroupBounds, int, int, int, int, int) returns empty.
